stemMarkdown: Two positive numbers add up to 40. What is the maximum possible value of their product?
solutionMarkdown: By AM-GM, for a fixed sum the product is largest when the numbers are equal. Each is $\dfrac{40}{2} = 20.0$, so the maximum product is $20.0 \times 20.0 = 400.0$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equality in AM-GM always happens when the terms are equal — that is what makes it an optimisation tool.
